newsitem.title: USA: CIBER Inc in pact to acquire KCM Computer.
newsitem.headline: CIBER Inc in pact to acquire KCM Computer.

text.p: CIBER Inc said Tuesday it had reached a definitive agreement to acquire KCM Computer Consulting Inc, a privately-held provider of information technology services.
CIBER announced the signing of a letter of intent for the transaction on June 26.
CIBER President and Chief Operating Officer Mac Slingerlend said he expects KCM to provide the company with greater expertise in the federal arena.
The company did not disclose the terms of the agreement.
CIBER provides information technology consulting services.
